## What RevFlow is

RevFlow is a revenue operations platform for multi-entity groups. It unifies B2C appliance
operations (warranty registry, dealer credit control, technician dispatch) with B2B
conglomerate pipeline (institutional opportunities, cross-vertical bundling) on eight core
records: Entity_Vertical, Account, Contact, Product_Catalog, Customer_Asset,
B2B_Opportunity, Channel_Order and Service_Ticket. It syncs with SAP S/4HANA, Oracle
NetSuite and Microsoft Dynamics 365, and takes warranty intake from WhatsApp.

The public demo runs on seeded Pakistani data (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, PKR pricing)
with four role-based personas and a 14-day retention window. Demo accounts are purged
automatically after 14 days.
